name: browse_page
description: Navigate the browser to a webpage (or read the active page) to return clean, noise-pruned Markdown content. Automatically strips headers, navigation bars, footers, and modal overlays to prevent context bloat. Supports CSS selector scoping and outline/links extraction modes.

url.description: Optional URL to navigate to. If omitted, reads and inspects the currently active page.

wait_until.description: Navigation wait strategy: 'domcontentloaded' (fast, default), 'load', or 'networkidle'. Prefer 'domcontentloaded' for SPAs (Jira, Teams, Confluence) to avoid long network-idle timeouts.

wait_for_selector.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for before extracting content. Essential for single-page applications (Jira, Confluence, Gemini, GitHub) that render content or stream responses asynchronously.

wait_for_timeout_ms.description: Max milliseconds to wait for wait_for_selector before extracting content (default 10000).

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to scope content extraction to a specific container (e.g. 'article', '#main-content', '.guide-body').

mode.description: Extraction mode: 'content' (default, clean article markdown), 'outline' (headings H1-H6 hierarchy), or 'links' (markdown link directory).

max_length.description: Maximum character length of returned content before graceful truncation. Defaults to 25000.
